note: Escalation ladder for a claim that is stuck or wrongly rejected. Day counts are from the date the claim was filed.

ladder.name: Wait for normal processing
ladder.action: EPFO aims to settle claims within 20 days. Track status on the Member Portal / UMANG app.

ladder.name: EPFiGMS grievance
ladder.action: Raise a grievance on EPFO's own grievance portal with the claim ID and rejection reason. Save the Grievance Registration Number.

ladder.name: Reminder + CPGRAMS
ladder.action: Send a reminder on EPFiGMS, then file on CPGRAMS (Ministry of Labour & Employment → EPFO) quoting the EPFiGMS number. CPGRAMS has an appeal stage EPFiGMS lacks.

ladder.name: RTI application
ladder.action: File an RTI with the regional EPFO office asking for the exact reason, the officer who handled it, and the date it was last acted on. ₹10 fee; reply legally due in 30 days.

ladder.name: Regional office / public escalation
ladder.action: Visit or email the Regional PF Commissioner with all reference numbers. Optionally post politely on EPFO's official social media handle with grievance numbers (never post UAN or Aadhaar publicly).
